title: truth-order
description: The order <=_t of a pre-bilattice's truth lattice - the twist order on charges: it raises positive evidence and lowers negative. Its bottom is false, its top true.

twisted.description: [a1,a2] <=_t [b1,b2] iff a1 <= b1 and b2 <= a2 - positive raised, negative lowered; negation is antitone in it
